profile: Nykode Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing modular immunotherapy and vaccine candidates based on its Vaccibody platform. Its pipeline includes abi-suva, an off-the-shelf therapeutic vaccine for HPV16-positive cancers, and VB10.NEO, an individualized neoantigen vaccine for solid tumors. The company also pursues autoimmune programs and selective partnerships to advance development.
